|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Hound's Tooth (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Hound's Tooth (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The original title omits the apostrophe. The later slip adds a vehicle slot and fixes Bossk’s attrition immunity at less than 4. It drops the Bossk power bonus and the ship-docking clause. Both keep the original subtype, matching Bossk battle destiny, and starfighter movement. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=85 Period ship-docking capability].
